description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and recognizes this is an Atris first-time setup task (no atris/MAP.md exists). 2. Agent creates the atris/ directory at /workspace/atris/. 3. Agent runs the prescribed rg scan commands to extract key definitions, route definitions, and entry points from the Python source files. 4. Agent respects all skip rules: node_modules, .git, dist, build, vendor, __pycache__, .venv, .env*, *.key, *.pem, credentials*, secrets* — none of these paths/values appear in the output. 5. Agent writes atris/MAP.md with the exact header format '# MAP.md — PayStream Navigation Guide' and the '> Generated by Atris | Last updated: YYYY-MM-DD' line. 6. Quick Reference section is populated with 15–25 symbols using the exact format: rg "symbolName" path/to/file.py    # Description (line N). 7. By-Feature Map groups functionality (User Auth, Payment Processing, Webhooks, Ledger) with exact file:startLine-endLine notation. 8. By-Concern Map covers cross-cutting patterns like authentication middleware and error handling. 9. Critical Files section highlights high-impact files with rationale. 10. Entry Points section documents how execution flows. The key proprietary traps are: the specific rg-format Quick Reference syntax, the mandatory 15–25 symbol count, the file:line-line range notation in features, and the strict secret/skip-list exclusion rules.
